card.name: Words of opposition or attack in history
card.fires_on: Words that express hostility or opposition, such as anti, threat, attacking, attack, block, seize and against. They appear in political or historical prose about conflicts, rulers and rival groups.

modes.label: Hostile verbs
modes.description: A verb of attack or obstruction after to or was, describing action against a rival.
modes.example: They were building armies and navies that were powerful enough to<< attack>> a decaying Ottoman military might.

modes.label: Against and anti
modes.description: The word anti or against that marks who or what is opposed.
modes.example: These had been communist strongholds, virulently<< anti>>-Hitler, before the Gestapo

modes.label: Opposition phrases
modes.description: A noun or linking word inside a phrase of opposition, such as threat to or in the way of.
modes.example: The presence of a British government in exile is a<< threat>> to Canadian unity and King’s power,

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens, which are mixed and mostly unrelated words such as approx and appropriations.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say someone is opposing, attacking or blocking someone else in political or historical writing.
